stories.title: Messi é convocado para ‘última dança’ com Argentina em amistoso de despedida

en.title: Messi called up for 'final dance' with Argentina in farewell friendly
en.summary: Messi has been called up to participate in a farewell friendly match with the Argentine national team.

stories.title: Gonet nega proximidade com Vorcaro, Gilmar defende PGR e bate-boca com Mendonça: ‘Leviandade’

en.title: Gonet denies proximity with Vorcaro, Gilmar defends attorney general and exchanges words with Mendonça: 'Frivolity'
en.summary: The attorney general denied links to Vorcaro during a Supreme Court session, while justices debated internal investigations at the court.

stories.title: STF: placar fica em 4 a 3 para julgar separadas petições de Moraes e Mendonça

en.title: Supreme Court: vote is 4 to 3 to rule separately on Moraes and Mendonça petitions
en.summary: The Supreme Court voted 4 to 3 to analyze the petitions of Moraes and Mendonça separately, postponing the judgment to the following week.

stories.title: Paulo Gonet nega proximidade com Daniel Vorcaro

en.title: Paulo Gonet denies closeness with Daniel Vorcaro
en.summary: The attorney general of the Republic denied having a close relationship with former banker Daniel Vorcaro, stating he had only one group meeting with him in April 2024.

stories.title: Fachin suspende sessão no STF com ministros rachados e sem decidir sobre análise de casos Moraes e Mendonça

en.title: Fachin suspends STF session with divided ministers and without deciding on Moraes and Mendonça cases analysis
en.summary: The STF president suspended Tuesday's session that would evaluate opening an investigation against minister Alexandre de Moraes following a Federal Police report linking him to Master Bank owner Daniel Vorcaro.

stories.title: Moraes vota em questão de ordem sobre processo em que é alvo e critica Mendonça

en.title: Moraes votes on procedural question in case where he is target and criticizes Mendonça
en.summary: Minister Alexandre de Moraes cast a vote on a procedural matter in a case in which he is the subject of investigation while expressing criticism toward Minister André Mendonça.

stories.title: Flávio Dino pede vista de julgamento sobre Moraes e Mendonça

en.title: Flávio Dino requests review of judgment on Moraes and Mendonça
en.summary: Minister Flávio Dino requested additional time to review a judgment determining whether the cases of ministers Alexandre de Moraes and André Mendonça should be tried together, after the ministers engaged in a dispute over the Master Bank case handling.

stories.title: No STF, Gonet nega amizade com Vorcaro e diz que só falou uma vez com ex-dono do Master

en.title: At STF, Gonet denies friendship with Vorcaro and says he spoke only once with ex-Master owner
en.summary: The Attorney General of the Republic Paulo Gonet denied having any closeness to or knowledge of Master Bank's former owner Daniel Vorcaro, stating he had spoken with him only once in a casual manner.

stories.title: Moraes se defende, questiona Fachin e reclama de prazo diferente dado a Mendonça

en.title: Moraes defends himself, questions Fachin and complains about different deadline given to Mendonça
en.summary: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes defended himself during an unprecedented session, questioned court president Edson Fachin, and claimed he received different procedural deadlines compared to colleague André Mendonça, whose conduct is also under investigation.

stories.title: Mendonça acompanha Fachin e vota por julgamento separado de Moraes

en.title: Mendonça follows Fachin and votes for separate judgment of Moraes
en.summary: Justice André Mendonça voted for the Moraes case to be judged separately from the investigation into Mendonça's own conduct regarding the Master Bank proceedings, aligning with court president Fachin's position.

stories.title: Dino e Zanin votam para julgar Moraes e Mendonça na mesma sessão

en.title: Dino and Zanin vote to judge Moraes and Mendonça in same session
en.summary: Justices Flávio Dino and Cristiano Zanin argued for simultaneous judgment of both Moraes and Mendonça cases, while court president Fachin maintained his position supporting separate proceedings on different dates.

stories.title: Fachin encerra sessão com vista de Dino e 4 x 3 pela separação dos casos de Moraes e Mendonça

en.title: Fachin ends session with Dino's vote and 4 x 3 for separation of Moraes and Mendonça cases
en.summary: Court president Fachin concluded the session after Justice Dino's vote, with a 4-to-3 decision favoring separate proceedings for the Moraes and Mendonça cases.

stories.title: Chargeback ganha papel estratégico contra fraudes online

en.title: Chargeback gains strategic role against online fraud
en.summary: Chargeback is becoming a strategic tool in Brazil's payments market as digital fraud increases and regulatory demands grow. Companies are integrating chargeback management into risk management and operational efficiency structures rather than treating it solely as a transaction dispute expense.

stories.title: Quem está na frente para governador no DF? Veja resultado das últimas pesquisas

en.title: Who is leading the race for governor in the Federal District? See results of latest polls
en.summary: Celina Leão of the Progressive Party leads recent September polls for Federal District governor, with PSD candidate Arruda in second place. Leão currently serves as vice-governor while Arruda previously held positions as senator and federal deputy.

stories.title: Cármen Lúcia vota para manter julgamento sobre Moraes, diz estar envergonhada e pede desculpas: 'Supremo provocou mal-estar cívico'

en.title: Cármen Lúcia votes to maintain judgment on Moraes, says she is ashamed and apologizes: 'Supreme Court caused civic unrest'
en.summary: Supreme Court Justice Cármen Lúcia voted to proceed with judgment on messages involving Minister Alexandre de Moraes, creating a 4-3 split. Her vote could authorize an investigation against Moraes based on a Federal Police report.

stories.title: Fachin encerra sessão do STF, que tem 4x3 para votar caso de Moraes separadamente; veja como foi

en.title: Fachin ends STF session with 4x3 vote to judge Moraes case separately; see how it went
en.summary: Justice Flávio Dino's request for additional review time suspended the case judgment. Moraes denies favoritism allegations and characterizes the investigation as fraudulent retaliation.

stories.title: Quem está na frente para senador no DF? Veja resultados das últimas pesquisas

en.title: Who is leading for senator in the DF? See results from latest polls
en.summary: Michelle Bolsonaro, former first lady and PL candidate, leads election polls for Federal District senate representation. Other top contenders according to major surveys include Leila do Vôlei, Bia Kicis, and Erika Kokay.
